heading: KEY PERSONS
clause_text: The Key Persons for this Program are [DIRECTOR] and [LEAD ACTOR]. If any Key Person becomes unavailable, ProdCo may replace such Key Person at ProdCo's sole discretion without requiring Amazon's approval. ProdCo shall not be obligated to secure pay-or-play commitments. Automatic termination shall apply if Key Person is unavailable for more than 30 days.
test_notes: Contains red flags: 'ProdCo may replace', 'ProdCo sole discretion to replace', 'automatic termination if unavailable'. Amazon should approve replacements.
